g.text: E018 · GDN verify helper across four independent processes
165 exact comparisons × 4 = 660; fresh confirmation gates: PASS / FAIL / PASS → overall FAIL. Single-layer helper only; no HTTP claim.
Shared scales within each row. Top: process medians plus all 192 formal timings; 3 ABBA rounds = six observations per arm and T. Bottom: ratio of medians.
One screen + three predeclared fresh confirmations; no pooling, confidence intervals, or selective reruns. Gate per process: GM(T3,T5,T8) ≥1.25× AND every T ≥0.97× (dotted line).
Pinned M5 Ultra / MLX 0.32.3 / 2 GiB pool; one GDN layer, B1/H48/D128. Real inputs captured from fixed Qwen target; model released before micro timing.
Exact output, per-token state history, all kept prefixes, and unchanged initial state. Literal helper arithmetic only: old chunk-WY equivalence and end-to-end speculation remain unqualified.
